n01.text: Claude API · Runs the assistant conversation: understands what the seller types and generates the quick-reply chips (Sell an item / Donate an item).

n02.text: Cloudinary · Receives the uploaded photos, converts HEIC to JPEG, compresses them, strips GPS location data and serves them through a CDN.

n03.text: Claude API · Vision: looks at the photos and identifies the item, returning title, category and colour as structured data for the listing.

n04.text: Claude API · Vision: checks the photos for damage and detects that the back of the chair isn't visible yet, so it asks for another photo.

n05.text: Claude API · Vision: analyses the new photo of the back and adds the light marks to the condition description.

n06.text: Supabase · Database with pgvector + PostGIS: finds visually similar items sold nearby to suggest €45 and build the price collage.

n07.text: Supabase · Stores the lowest offer privately on the server. An Edge Function accepts or declines offers, so the AI chat can never reveal it to buyers.

n08.text: Google Maps Geocoding API · Turns the seller's location into a neighbourhood name (Gràcia, Barcelona), so buyers see the area but never the exact address.

n09.text: Supabase · Saves the sell-by date and runs scheduled jobs (pg_cron) to remind the seller or suggest a price drop before the deadline.

n10.text: Supabase · Stores the days the seller is available for buyers to collect the item.

n11.text: Supabase · Stores the time slots for each day and makes sure two buyers can't book the same slot.

n12.text: Cloudinary · Crops and enhances the hero photo so the preview shows the item exactly as buyers will see it.

n13.text: OneSignal · Sends push notifications to buyers nearby when the item goes live, and to the seller when offers arrive or it sells.
